name: Datto RMM
summary: Datto RMM is built for managed service providers and is sold by quote only. Its product page offers a trial on request and links to a separate pricing request form. A lightweight agent on each managed device reports to the platform, with scripting, policies, webhooks, patch deployment and alerts that can respond automatically.

facts.text: Datto says RMM was assessed in its first Building Security In Maturity Model (BSIMM) review; the page does not mention SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
The platform runs in five regions: two in Ireland, two in the US and one in Sydney, Australia.
A native Microsoft 365 management module is included, with integrations for Autotask PSA, SIRIS and Cloud Managed WiFi.

plans.name: Quote
plans.notes: No prices published; the page offers Request Pricing and Request A Trial links
